{{Quote|Kaas City has an arboretum in the lower levels. I'm sure this was beautiful, but it hardly compares.|Raina Temple|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
An '''arboretum''' was located in the lower levels of [[Kaas City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. [[Raina Temple]] considered it far more beautiful than the destroyed [[Axial Park]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].
